title: Liquidity Services $LQDT just lost almost a fifth of its value, -18.8% to $35.71.
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
The spark: fiscal Q4 revenue fell 10% to $106.4M, and GMV of $404M landed below the company's own $415M-$455M range. The small EPS beat ($0.46 vs $0.45) didn't save it.  
  
Yesterday (Wed, Nov 18) it closed at $43.97, up about 45% on the year. Today (Thu, Nov 19) it's trading around $35.71.
